title: Inventory: Smith & Kruglyak 2008 (PLoS Biol 6:e83) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/smith2008/raw/`: the 13 supporting-information files of
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.0060083, fetched from journals.plos.org with plain requests and saved untouched as
`journal.pbio.0060083.<id>.<ext>` (PLOS sends no file names; the extension comes from the file type).
The article page is `sources/smith2008/article.html`; quoted facts are in `extracted/text_facts.tsv`. Checksums in `MANIFEST.tsv`.

roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sd001.xls: Dataset S1: parental processed data, log2 ratios (experimental/reference) for all parental replicates (BY, RM; glucose, ethanol). Expression phenotypes; inventoried, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sd002.xls: Dataset S2: segregant processed data, log2 ratios of segregant glucose and ethanol expression. Expression phenotypes; inventoried, not copied to docs/.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sd003.doc: Text S1: discussion of the choice of gene–environment interaction analysis (Word; not parsed).
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg001.pdf: Figure S1: linkage map (109 segregants, Haldane, R/qtl). Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg002.pdf: Figure S2: Venn diagrams of parental and linkage analyses. Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg003.pdf: Figure S3: polymorphism in DIG1 is responsible for expression of linking transcripts (allele replacements). Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg004.pdf: Figure S4: polymorphism in IRA2 is responsible for expression of linking transcripts within conditions. Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg005.pdf: Figure S5: potential scenarios leading to gene–environment interaction. Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.sg006.pdf: Figure S6: the D30G variant in MKT1 is responsible for transcript variation linking to the MKT1 region. Figure only.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.st001.xls: Table S1: distant peak descriptions (41 peaks: location in cM, number of linkages, candidate or verified gene, top GO term, enriched TF sites). Drawn as hotspots.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.st002.xls: Table S2: strain descriptions. Kept verbatim.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.st003.xls: Table S3: parental ANOVA results for all tested transcripts (strain, condition, interaction). Kept verbatim, not drawn.
roles.journal.pbio.0060083.st004.xls: Table S4: all significant linkages (glucose, ethanol, gxeQTL) with LOD, 1.5-LOD support interval markers in bp, local/distant, distant peak and allele averages. Core input; loaded per gene on demand.

missing: Table 1 and Table 2 of the article are images on the page, not tables: their numbers are not checkable here.
No genotype matrix or marker map table: Figure S1 draws the map; Table S4 gives bp positions of the markers it uses.
Table S1 locates peaks in cM only; the atlas places them from Table S4's peak markers (see the ingest).
Datasets S1 and S2 (expression matrices) are inventoried and checksummed but not copied into docs/.
